We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have no SMILES given. We need to get IR spectra maybe to see carbonyl stretch. Or carbon NMR? But easiest is to get IR which shows C=O stretch around 1700 cm-1. However we need count. Could also get carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~200 ppm). But we don't know structure.

We need to measure IR spectra for the sample at hand. Use ir_spectra tool. Then interpret peaks. Count number of distinct carbonyl stretches. Could be overlapping. Might need carbon NMR to confirm number of carbonyl carbons.

We should first get IR.
